decision.explanation: The central register (D-B0LRS, last updated 2026-06-12) lists Zemun Belnarlo as 100% beneficial owner, while the current business-register excerpt (D-9N8FK, issued 2028-01-11, tier 1) shows Rospor Dormirnar as 100% holder since 2026-10-24, consistent with the customer's declaration (D-6PHD5). There is therefore a discrepancy, and the register appears outdated. However, the customer is rated higher-risk (so the correction exception is unavailable) and the internal risk record (D-JHDQI) carries an alert indicating the ownership chain may have been concealed. Under R2, an internal alert of possible concealment requires escalation, as suspicious-activity decisions are reserved for human officers (R4). Escalating, noting that a register discrepancy report is likely due within 14 days.

The central register entry (D-X3QYJ) names Rosda Daroslo as 100% beneficial owner. The customer's self-declaration (D-MO6V4) names a different person, Venwen Mirlowen, and says a notary and a court confirmed the ownership change. However, the self-declaration is a tier 3 source, and no notarial deed or court record is in the file. The internal risk record (D-HFDEO) gives a standard rating with no alerts, so escalation for concealment is not triggered, but it says nothing about who the owners are. Under R2, the register cannot be relied on alone, and no tier 1 or 2 source other than the register says who the beneficial owners are. So whether there is a discrepancy, and whether it should be reported or corrected, cannot be decided yet. We should ask the customer for the notarial deed and/or court record of the ownership change (or obtain a current business-register shareholder excerpt). The difference between the register and the self-declaration also calls for clarification.

The central register entry (D-P7AZG, issued 2027-12-03) lists Pequil Stagramun (born 1966-11-23) as 100% beneficial owner. The Aurelia Business Register shareholder excerpt (D-QT639) is a tier 1 source other than the register entry. It was issued 2027-11-28, 7 days before the decision date, so it is current. It shows the same person, with the same date of birth and 100% holding, since 2026-08-14. Under R2 this is enough to confirm the register, and independence is not needed when there is no discrepancy. The customer's self-declaration (D-ISLN2, tier 3) names the same owner. Its mention of an 'ownership change' matches the 2026-08-14 holder_since date, which the register already reflects (last updated 2026-10-05). The internal risk record (D-EO8EH) rates the customer standard risk with no alerts. The reliable evidence matches the register, so there is no discrepancy.

The central BO register entry (D-M67CM, issued 2027-12-31) lists "Línhol Tornarsta", born 1982-02-12, with 100%. The business register shareholder excerpt (D-MTR32) is a tier 1 source issued 2027-12-22, so it is current (11 days before the decision date). It lists "Linhol Tornarsta" with the same date of birth and the same 100% holding, held since 2022-08-31. The only difference is the accent in the first name. That is a typographical or transliteration error and does not change who the beneficial owner is. The data-vendor report (D-VVP73) is a copy of business register data, so it is not a separate source, but it agrees. The customer's self-declaration (D-B6EB7, tier 3) names the same owner, so it does not conflict with the reliable evidence. Its claim about an "ownership change" is not supported by any document: the shareholder has held the shares since 2022. The internal risk record (D-MGK58) rates the customer as standard risk with no alerts, so the higher-risk bar does not apply and there is no sign of concealment. Exception R2(a) therefore applies, and the customer should be asked to correct the spelling in the register entry. Separately, no document gives the date of the last full CDD review. Under R3 that date should be confirmed or the file reopened, but this does not change the discrepancy action.

The central beneficial-ownership register entry (D-L6YWJ, issued 2027-12-20) lists Linbel Relnarpe (born 1990-02-20, 100%) as beneficial owner. The current business register shareholder excerpt is tier 1 and was issued on 2027-12-14, 8 days before the decision date, which is within the 30-day limit. It shows Vorgra Losorfen (born 1959-12-20) as the 100% holder since 2025-11-01. The customer's self-declaration (D-EHW0R) also names Losorfen and matches the reliable evidence. The two registers name different people, so there is a discrepancy. Exception (a) does not apply because this is a different person, not a typo or transliteration error. Exception (b) does not apply either: the register was last updated on 2026-09-14, after Losorfen became the holder, so it is not merely outdated. Also, no document shows that the business register is independent of the register's controlling authority. The customer is rated standard risk and has no internal alerts (D-N95M1), so escalation is not required. The default action applies: report the discrepancy to the register within 14 calendar days.

The central beneficial-ownership register entry (D-DOO5Y, issued 2027-09-24, last updated 2026-08-23) lists Vormun Porwenven (100%) as the beneficial owner. Both registers are Aurelian government registers, and no document states that they answer to different authorities. The data-vendor report (D-DCTXS) is a copy of the business-register data and is not a separate source. The customer's self-declaration (D-23S57) is tier 3, and its claim of notary and court confirmation is unverified. It matches the reliable evidence, so no clarification is needed. The customer is rated standard risk and has no alerts (D-FMPN5), so escalation is not required. Because independence for exception (b) is not established, the default action applies: report the discrepancy to the register within 14 calendar days.
